title: Making a phone call
scenario: Making an administrative phone call, you explain a minor delay in reports.

dialogue.setting: Office, on the phone, Friday afternoon

lines.text: I am calling to apologise for the delay in sending the report.
No problem. I understand you were very busy last week.
I will submit the completed report by tomorrow morning.
Thank you. Could you also send a digital copy by email?
Of course. I will attach it to my email tonight.
If you had called earlier, I can have helped you.
I understand. I should have contacted you sooner.
No need to worry. I look forward to receiving the report.
